Actual web layout, edge to edge, no device or browser chrome. Brand: Birdcar, one expert bringing Silicon Valley technical capability into established businesses. User wants clean, classic, typography-and-animation-led sophistication; technical glitz is welcome, with a direct human voice.

STRUCTURE, in reading order:
1. A very quiet top navigation occupying about 90px; Birdcar wordmark in Alkaline at left, compact Karla links at right: How I work, Selected work, Writing, then a quiet outlined Book a free assessment link. Spacious horizontal margins of 100px.
2. A large centered typographic opening on a continuous deep BLACK-CHERRY field (#291e2e, visibly plum not neutral black). No eyebrow or category label above the headline. Dominant statement in real-looking Alkaline by Fort Foundry: "Make room" on first line, "for better work." on second. Approximate Alkaline accurately: confident forward-leaning mid-century connected brush script, substantial strokes, elongated expressive lowercase, not serif italic and not delicate calligraphy. Pale orchid (#f5f0f8) solid-color text. Large but extraordinarily well balanced; head occupies x300-1240, y160-350. Keep strong legibility and generous air.
3. Directly below at center, 2 readable lines in Karla medium at about 23px: "I help businesses untangle work that’s become harder to keep up with." Below that, one compact 2-line explanation in Karla regular, about 18px, max width 720px: "The reporting someone spends Friday assembling. The follow-up that depends on your memory. The process that keeps landing back on your desk."
4. A clearly visible pale lilac rectangular button, gently rounded 6px corners, dark plum readable text "Book a free assessment" with a simple right arrow. Just beneath in small but readable restrained mono: "About an hour. A free assessment. A report to keep."
5. Across the lower quarter, a precise luminous HORIZON: one hairline of cool pale lavender (#c9b4ed) with a delicate rose (#dda8c7) reflection spreading a few centimeters, a cinematic optical light event at the fold. It is an ambient reflection over a smooth page surface, not a neon tube, tunnel, sphere, ribbon illustration, sci-fi object, textured scene, or gradient lettering. All other areas stay calm and crisp. This single visual event evokes a sophisticated Motion-powered opening of space. Don't put visual effects behind the reading area.
6. Beginning around y800, a quiet porcelain/pale-orchid lower section appears, with "Work in practice." in modest Alkaline on left, "Craft & Communicate" in dark Karla semibold on right and visible real description: "I built a client-facing reporting platform that brings together performance data and gives the agency something it can offer its customers." Use a quiet text action "Read about the work". This is prose evidence, no fabricated product UI.

ART DIRECTION: personal technical briefing; a great software identity interpreted through an unmistakable human signature. Fine typography, excellent optical alignment, natural paragraph measure. Alkaline logo and two short display headings, KARLA candid body sans, COMMIT MONO only the small factual meeting detail. One dominant move: expressive pale script over black cherry, opening onto a thin optical horizon. Motion is suggested by composition, the image itself is a stable resting frame. No desktop widgets, no giant glowing geometry, no background grid, no cards, no statistics, no rating stars, no endorsements, no screenshots, no stock people, no illustrations, no marketing label above the headline. No old mustard, terracotta, teal or cream identity. Preserve all quoted words. Treat as finished website, not a poster.
